title: Creative Weapon Doesn't Mine
description: Adds an item tag that mimics the behavior of certain weapons being unable to break blocks while in creative mode.
body:
Adds an item tag that mimics the behavior of certain weapons not breaking blocks while you are in creative mode. For instance, swords.

This could be useful for modpack creators.

-----

The tag that makes items behave like this is called:

```
creative_weapon_doesnt_mine:affected_items
```

-----
